title: 第二章 意外收获
slug: 网游之剑刃舞者全本免费-网游之剑刃舞者最新章节列表
content_zh:
出了村子一看，好家伙！到处都是杀兔子的人，所拿的武器那是杂七杂八什么都有。林铮检查了一下自己的包裹，一把做得还算精致的匕首，一件布衣，没了！
新人匕首：物理攻击30-55法术攻击30-55已绑定永不磨损
新人布衣：物理防御22已绑定永不磨损
装备上后人物基本属性是
一平道人（射手）
力量：4
智力：1
体力：2
敏捷：1
精力：1
物理攻击：39-73
法术攻击：33-60
物理防御：30
法术防御：2
气血：100
法力：100
看了下技能，嗯，没一转之前貌似只有一个，
投掷：1级，熟练度0/100使用武器投掷敌人，物理攻击增加10%，命中下降20%使用距离1-20米
一个有了跟没的似的技能，这武器扔出去又不会跑回来，这扔了武器还怎么打怪啊！林铮腹诽着看着其他人打怪，很快又发现了自己的无知。要知道新手武器都是绑定的，《幻灵贰》的设定是，绑定的装备除非玩家自己销毁或贩卖商店，不然是不会丢失的，也就是你扔了它，它也会自己跑回你手里，所以用技能投掷扔出去的武器会在攻击行为结束后自动回到玩家手中，没看见一个个拿匕首的都成小李飞刀了吗？林铮一乐，这敢情好，多方便啊！这游戏还真会体贴新手。好！就让他拿只兔子来试试手！
一只兔子刚巧刷到了林铮面前，呦！还是只3级的，不过没问题，不就是只兔子嘛！林铮一个箭步上前，大脚一踢，兔子马上就给踢上了天，-53飘了起来，看准时机，匕首一下甩了出去，中！-65！两步奔上前，手握回收的匕首一跳，一下将兔子钉到地上，-120!好家伙，致命一击！

好吧，林铮承认，他这么杀兔子是有耍帅的心思，不过看到几只侏罗纪的食肉生物满眼星星地看着他，还是把他吓得落荒而逃。
林铮微高级的怪来杀杀。嗯，现在在野兔坡，再跑一点路就能到绿树林了，那里是4-12级的怪物区域，这里应该差不多吧！林铮看着地图，快速地跑了过去。到了绿树林一看，哟呵！这人也不少！一个个和大肥老鼠打得不亦乐乎。那么好吧，咱继续走，看能碰到什么牛掰的怪。不过林铮很快就郁闷地退回来了，他碰到了8级的猴子，他身手敏捷，猴子是很难打到他，关键他也打不到猴子啊！等级差太多，攻击被闪掉的几率太高了，加上攻击不够，堪堪破防的伤害实在不咋地，这打起来可是超级不划算，所以他也只有灰溜溜地跑回头杀老鼠玩了。
杀了一个多小时的大老鼠，林铮升到了6级，琢磨着该换个地方了，但就在这个时候有人大喊一声：“出boss啦！出boss啦！！”
哈？Boss？林铮来了精神，跟着人群朝发出声音的地方跑去。为什么人家发现boss了要大声叫呢？自己杀了多划算！嘛，关键还是这个人有自知之明，现在一个个的都是新手装备，想杀个同级数的boss除了群殴还真没有办法，没办法那就喊人啰！这一喊！哗——！一下子几十号人就涌过去了！林铮也在人群中，左钻右钻的终于钻到前线，一看boss，好家伙，8级的硕鼠头领，青铜boss，由于杀boss的人实在是太多了，boss的血那是十几十几的哗啦啦一直掉，没一会儿都残血了，果然群众的力量是强大的啊！林铮小小地感叹了一下，不过手下可没含糊，已经很不客气地扎了boss好几下了。Boss的气血有8000左右，好家伙，这还不到两分钟就要挂了，当然了，好歹也是个牛哄哄的boss，攻击次数虽然没几次，但已经秒杀了不少的新手了！林铮要不是动作敏捷点，少不得也得免费回村一趟！
林铮睁大了双眼盯着地上，随时准备抢boss爆的东西，要知道这游戏boss掉落的东西是没有保护的，谁抢到就是谁的！终于，硕鼠头领“吱吱！”惨叫了一下，死亡倒地。虽然这是个小的不能再小的boss，到好歹还是首杀，居然来了个大爆，顿时是一地的铜板，好不壮观！林铮可没有心思感叹，一手刚刚抓到一件东西，没没来得及看是什么就给挤出去了。好吧，僧多粥少，咱也不能贪心不是？林铮自我安慰了一下离开了人群，实则严重鄙视了一番围抢的家伙，等四周没什么人了这才拿出东西来一看。
小主子，这个章节后面还有哦 ^.^，请点击下一页继续    喜欢网游之剑刃舞者请大家
content_en:
After leaving the village, I saw, what a guy! There are people killing rabbits everywhere, with all kinds of weapons. Lin Zheng checked his package. A rather exquisitely made dagger and a piece of cloth were gone!
Newcomer's dagger: physical attack 30-55, spell attack 30-55, bound and never worn
Newcomer Commoner: Physical Defense 22 is bound and will never wear out
After equipping the equipment, the basic attributes of the character are:
Yiping Taoist (shooter)
Strength: 4
Intelligence: 1
Stamina: 2
Agility: 1
Energy: 1
Physical attack: 39-73
Spell Attack: 33-60
Physical Defense: 30
Spell Defense: 2
Qi and blood: 100
Mana: 100
After looking at the skills, well, there seemed to be only one before I changed it.
Throwing: Level 1, proficiency 0/100 Use the weapon to throw the enemy, the physical attack increases by 10%, the hit decreases by 20%, the usage range is 1-20 meters
A person who has a skill that seems to have no skills, and the weapon will not come back when thrown, how can he defeat monsters if he throws the weapon! Lin Zheng cursed as he watched the others fight monsters, and soon discovered his own ignorance. You must know that novice weapons are bound. The setting of "Phantom 2" is that the bound equipment will not be lost unless the player destroys it or sells it in the store. That is, if you throw it, it will run back to your hand. Therefore, the weapon thrown by skill throwing will automatically return to the player's hand after the attack is over. Didn't you see that everyone holding daggers becomes Xiao Li's flying knives? Lin Zheng was delighted, this is such a great thing, how convenient it is! This game is really considerate of newbies. good! Let him try his hand at a rabbit!
A rabbit happened to brush up in front of Lin Zheng, yo! It’s still only level 3, but no problem, it’s just a rabbit! Lin Zheng stepped forward and kicked with his big foot. The rabbit was immediately kicked into the sky. -53 floated up. Seeing the right moment, he swung the dagger out and hit it! -65! He ran forward in two steps, jumped with the recovered dagger in his hand, and nailed the rabbit to the ground, -120! Good guy, a fatal blow!
Okay, Lin Zheng admitted that he killed the rabbit like this to show off, but when he saw a few Jurassic carnivorous creatures looking at him with stars in their eyes, he was still scared and ran away.
Lin Zheng came to kill some high-level monsters. Well, now at Hare Slope, if you run a little further, you can reach the green forest. There is a monster area of ​​level 4-12, so it should be about the same here! Lin Zheng looked at the map and ran over quickly. When I arrived at the green forest, I saw, yo ho! There are quite a few of them! One by one, they had a great time fighting with the big fat mice. Okay then, let's keep walking and see if we can encounter any awesome monsters. However, Lin Zheng quickly retreated in frustration. He met a level 8 monkey. He was so agile that it was difficult for the monkey to hit him. The key point was that he couldn't hit the monkey either! The level difference was too big, the chance of being dodged by attacks was too high, and the attacks were not enough, so the damage that could break the defense was not very good. It was not cost-effective to fight, so he had no choice but to run back and kill mice in despair.
After killing the big rat for more than an hour, Lin Zheng reached level 6. He was thinking about changing places, but at this moment someone shouted: "The boss is out! The boss is out!!"
Huh? Boss? Lin Zheng became energetic and ran towards the place where the sound came from, following the crowd. Why do people shout loudly when they find the boss? What a bargain to kill yourself! Well, the key is that this person has self-awareness. Now everyone has novice equipment. If he wants to kill a boss of the same level, there is really no way other than group fights. If there is no way, then call someone! This shout! Wow——! All of a sudden, dozens of people rushed over! Lin Zheng was also in the crowd, and he finally got to the front line. He looked at the boss, good guy, the leader of the rat at level 8, a bronze boss. Because the person who killed the boss was reallyThere were too many. The boss's blood kept dropping in the dozens and dozens, and soon all was left. As expected, the power of the crowd is powerful! Lin Zheng sighed a little, but his subordinates did not hesitate and stabbed the boss several times very rudely. The boss's health is about 8,000. Good guy, he will die in less than two minutes. Of course, he is also an awesome boss. Although he only attacks a few times, he has already killed a lot of novices instantly! If Lin Zheng hadn't been quicker, he would have had to go back to the village for free!
Lin Zheng stared at the ground with his eyes wide open, ready to grab whatever the boss exploded at any time. You must know that the items dropped by the boss in this game are not protected, and whoever grabs them belongs to him! Finally, the leader of the Shuoshu screamed "Zhizhi!" and fell to the ground dead. Although this was a very small boss, it was still the first kill, and there was a big explosion, and there were copper coins all over the place. How spectacular! Lin Zheng had no intention of sighing. He just grabbed something with one hand and squeezed it out before he could see what it was. Well, there are too many monks but too little food, so we can’t be greedy, right? Lin Zheng comforted himself and left the crowd. In fact, he seriously despised the guys who gathered around him. He waited until there was no one around before taking out his things to take a look.
